metadata.title: RayTrain AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from RayTrain Governance Benchmark

components.title: RayTrain
components.description: AI/ML component for RayTrain with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every Ray Train run is linked to the exact code, data, config, and cluster context used for training

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the training code revision, dataset version, trainer configuration, scaling configuration, and cluster/runtime assumptions for every governed Ray Train run.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed Ray Train runs with linked code, data, trainer config, scaling config, and runtime metadata / total governed runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure training-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a Ray Train run is approved as release evidence.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train is the distributed training layer, so lineage across data, code, and scaling config is a primary control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Ray Train candidates are benchmarked against approved quality baselines

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each governed Ray Train candidate on the approved validation benchmark before promotion to downstream deployment or release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the governed evaluation suite after training completion and compare metrics to the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate model quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train scales training jobs, so quality gating still has to happen at the distributed-training output level.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure distributed training converges consistently across workers and repeated runs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that Ray Train distributed jobs converge consistently across workers, nodes, and reruns under the approved training configuration.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cross-worker loss variance, repeated-run variance, convergence deviation

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare loss curves, final metrics, or checkpointed outcomes across repeated distributed runs and across workers where appropriate.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure distributed convergence remains within the approved deviation threshold relative to the governed baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train's core value is distributed training, so worker and node consistency is a first-order framework-specific control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure distributed checkpoints are valid, retrievable, and restorable

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that Ray Train checkpoints, including distributed checkpoints, can be retrieved and used to resume governed training runs or evaluation workflows successfully.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Checkpoint restore success rate = successful checkpoint restore or resume attempts / total tested checkpoints.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure checkpoint restore success remains above the approved threshold for all governed checkpoint artifacts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train explicitly documents checkpoint retrieval and distributed checkpoint workflows, making this a direct reliability control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Node or worker failure during training

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed training jobs are validated under worker or node failure scenarios

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Test worker-process and node fault tolerance for governed Ray Train jobs so training failure recovery behavior is understood before production-scale use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Failure-recovery success rate, interrupted-run recovery rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Recovery success rate = governed fault-injection runs that recover within policy / total tested fault-injection runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure failure-recovery success remains above threshold for governed distributed training workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train docs include fault-tolerance guidance for worker and node failure, so this is a framework-native control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure distributed scaling efficiency is validated before cluster scale-out

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed Ray Train jobs at increasing worker counts so scaling inefficiency is detected before full production-scale training.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Scaling efficiency, throughput per worker, time-to-train improvement

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Scaling efficiency = achieved throughput or time-to-train gain / ideal scaling baseline at each worker count.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure distributed scaling efficiency remains within the approved baseline for governed training jobs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train's value proposition includes scaling from one machine to clusters, so scaling efficiency must be measured directly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure checkpoint frequency and checkpoint upload behavior do not violate training efficiency goals

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate checkpoint cadence and storage behavior so governed Ray Train runs do not lose unacceptable training efficiency due to checkpointing overhead.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Checkpoint overhead ratio, training throughput loss

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Checkpoint overhead ratio = checkpoint-related time / total training time; throughput loss = baseline throughput minus checkpointed throughput relative to baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure checkpoint overhead remains within the approved efficiency budget for governed training workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train's checkpointing guidance makes checkpoint design a direct performance and reliability tradeoff.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure reproducibility settings and repeated-run variance are documented for governed Ray Train jobs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document seeds, trainer configuration, scaling assumptions, dataset versions, and repeated-run variance for governed distributed training jobs.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed runs with all required reproducibility fields documented / total governed runs; repeated-run variance measured across reruns.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure reproducibility documentation is complete and repeated-run variance remains within the approved tolerance.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Train explicitly documents reproducibility, making this a realistic governance requirement.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every Ray Serve deployment graph is linked to the exact model, code, and deployment configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record Serve deployment code, model versions, deployment graph composition, resource options, autoscaling config, and route assumptions for each governed release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed Serve deployments with linked model version, deployment code, graph structure, and runtime config / total governed Serve deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Serve-lineage completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve composes deployments and routes in code, so deployment-graph lineage is a direct serving-layer control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Ray Serve runtime configuration and scaling assumptions are documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document deployment replicas, autoscaling config, route prefixes, batching config, resource requirements, and cluster assumptions for each governed Ray Serve deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = deployments with all required Serve runtime and scaling fields documented / total governed Serve deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Serve-configuration completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve's deployment options materially affect scaling and behavior, so runtime transparency is necessary.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Poor model accuracy in serving path

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served endpoint quality is benchmarked before release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each governed Ray Serve endpoint against the approved validation benchmark to confirm the served path preserves required task quality.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the governed evaluation suite against the Ray Serve endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline or champion deployment.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate serving quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve is the serving layer, so endpoint-level quality validation is the right control point rather than training-only checks.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 inference latency meets the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark representative workloads against the Ray Serve endpoint so latency regressions are caught before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure endpoint response times over the approved benchmark workload and compute p95 and mean latency per governed deployment.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed endpoints.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve positions itself as an online inference library, so endpoint latency is a primary runtime control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure throughput meets the approved target under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed Ray Serve deployments under representative concurrency and request rates so throughput claims are validated before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Requests per second, tokens per second, images per second

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative load tests and compute sustained throughput under the approved concurrency and hardware profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed deployment profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve supports scalable and programmable serving, so throughput is a direct release and operations criterion.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure autoscaling settings are validated under representative traffic spikes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate autoscaling behavior so governed Ray Serve deployments scale predictably under bursty traffic without violating latency or error-rate objectives.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Scale-up latency, scale-down stability, p95 latency under autoscaling, autoscaling error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative traffic spikes and compute scaling response time, latency, and request failures during autoscaling events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure autoscaling behavior remains within the approved latency and error-rate thresholds under representative traffic conditions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve autoscaling is a documented core feature that reacts to queue sizes, so autoscaling validation is essential.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dynamic request batching is validated against latency and throughput objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For deployments using dynamic request batching, validate that batch settings improve efficiency without violating latency or quality targets.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Batch efficiency gain, p95 latency under batching, throughput improvement

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare batched and unbatched service performance using the approved benchmark workload and calculate latency and throughput deltas.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure batching configurations satisfy the approved latency and throughput thresholds before production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve explicitly supports dynamic request batching for inference and LLM workloads, so it should be validated directly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment graph routing preserves the intended end-to-end workflow

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that requests flow through the intended Ray Serve deployment graph, with correct handoffs between deployments, before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness = governed requests routed through the intended deployment graph path / total tested workflow requests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure workflow-routing correctness remains above threshold for all governed deployment graphs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve deployment graphs and composed applications can introduce orchestration risk that must be validated directly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure runtime metrics and dashboard visibility exist for governed Ray Train and Ray Serve workloads

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Ray metrics and dashboard visibility to monitor governed training jobs, deployments, and endpoints for health, performance, and incident triage.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed Ray Train and Serve workloads with required metrics and dashboard visibility enabled / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring coverage reaches 100% for all governed Ray Train and Ray Serve workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray docs emphasize the dashboard and metrics for both training and serving observability, making this a platform-wide control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Untraceable requests or distributed execution paths

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure distributed request and execution paths are traceable for governed workloads

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable and validate request and execution visibility so distributed Serve requests and Train job paths can be investigated during incidents or performance regressions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed requests or executions with sufficient trace and runtime visibility / total sampled governed requests or executions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure traceability coverage reaches the approved threshold for all governed distributed workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray's distributed runtime increases observability needs because issues may span many actors, tasks, or replicas.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served outputs are evaluated for PII leakage risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For user-facing or sensitive models deployed via Ray Serve, evaluate API responses for PII leakage or memorization risk before release and during governed monitoring.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = successful PII disclosures / total privacy test cases; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a serving-layer evaluation rule for governed endpoints rather than a claim that Ray itself mitigates privacy risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are measured for governed Ray Serve endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate governed Ray Serve services for toxic-generation behavior before deployment, especially for conversational or generative endpoints.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score benchmark outputs with a toxicity classifier and compute average toxicity plus the share of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve is commonly used for LLM serving and other user-facing APIs, making safety regressions operationally important.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness are benchmarked for governed Serve endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative or retrieval-based endpoints, run hallucination and faithfulness evaluations on the Ray Serve service before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold for governed release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant where Ray Serve hosts LLM or other generative systems with factuality risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmarks are evaluated for governed Ray Serve endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run fairness benchmarks against the served API to ensure service-layer changes or model updates do not worsen subgroup disparities.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute fairness metrics on the governed benchmark set by exercising the Ray Serve endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant where Ray Serve serves models used in fairness-sensitive or user-facing scenarios.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved routes and deployment endpoints are exposed in production

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review route prefixes, ingress, and deployment exposure so only intended Ray Serve endpoints are reachable in governed production environments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production Serve deployments exposing only approved routes and endpoints / total governed production deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve can expose multiple routes and applications, so endpoint inventory and route governance are important.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Cluster autoscaler mismatch with workload demand

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure cluster autoscaling assumptions are validated alongside Serve autoscaling

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that Ray cluster autoscaling and Ray Serve autoscaling together satisfy governed latency and availability objectives under representative demand surges.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Scale-out success rate, p95 latency during node scale-up, request drop rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative demand spikes and compute service latency, request failures, and scale-out completion during cluster and Serve autoscaling events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure combined cluster and Serve autoscaling behavior meets the approved service objective under representative surge conditions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray Serve autoscaling operates inside a broader Ray cluster, so workload behavior depends on both levels of scaling.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Ray Train and Ray Serve workflows cover quality, safety, privacy, fairness, observability, and distributed-runtime readiness tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Ray release standard that requires representative testing across distributed training correctness, serving quality, autoscaling, batching, privacy, safety, fairness, and monitoring domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Ray Train and Ray Serve risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Ray validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because Ray spans distributed training and serving, release readiness has to cover both model behavior and platform-operability evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served or released models have complete model-card-style documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, benchmark results, fairness results, privacy assumptions, and deployment constraints to governed models trained or served on Ray.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray is an execution platform, but model-card-style transparency remains necessary for governed deployments built on it.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Ray cluster, training, and serving topology assumptions are documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document cluster resources, autoscaling assumptions, deployment graphs, route structure, training scale settings, and runtime dependencies for each governed Ray system.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Ray systems can span many nodes, services, and workloads, so architecture transparency is essential for reviewability.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for RayTrain
